title: Joint Identified Sets for Mediation Effects with Ordered Mediators in Encouragement Trials
banked_reason: D0.5 graded the sound, fully discharged paper subfield with paper_score_ceiling 6.7 below the fixed field floor 7.4; confidence width, efficient certification, and a compatible substantive application require materially new programs.
gap_reasons: The inference result guarantees conservative whole-set coverage, but neither its width nor the computational cost of the exact support certificate is controlled.

The stated JOBS II plug-in law is incompatible, and the note supplies no compatible worked example showing how much the joint restrictions change a substantive conclusion; those limits constrain its projected paper score.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the target-aware quotient, sharp complier rectangle and noncomplier prisms, the exact four-halfspace monotonicity clipping and strictness criterion, and a finite algebraic mixed-support certificate, with a K=1 recovery bridge to Liang--Wu. The mathematics and citations passed review, but the package reached only subfield: confidence width is uncontrolled under arbitrarily weak complier share, exact support enumeration has no efficient complexity guarantee, and the JOBS II plug-in law is incompatible. Reaching field would require a new weak-first-stage minimax/adaptive frontier, a genuine complexity theorem, or a compatible substantive application.
tldr: For a randomized encouragement trial with binary treatment and outcome, finite ordered mediator, no defiers, and mediator order, the joint population/complier ACME and NDE identified set is the explicit image \(\Phi_p(E_0(p))\). The complier indirect pair is a sharp rectangle; never-taker and always-taker contributions form jointly attainable constant-size prisms. Within-treatment outcome monotonicity clips the full joint set by four sign halfspaces, with strict tightening exactly when \(H_0+H_1+L_N+L_T>0\). The binary case recovers Liang--Wu's sharp scalar intervals under their matching Assumptions 1--5 and 1--6 while retaining joint coexistence information. Simultaneous outer coverage and a finite denominator-aware mixed-support certificate handle sampling uncertainty, including \(\pi_C\downarrow0\) limits under stated input representations.
gap: The closest binary work reports scalar bounds. Known ordered transport does not settle joint outcome-label allocation, noncomplier effects, or direct-effect decompositions.
fill: Prove or refute the compact joint geometry and four-halfspace comparison, establish observable strictness, and support them with certified confidence projection.
